basics.name: Jacob Tutt
basics.label: PhD Candidate | Bayesian Inference | Machine Learning | Distributed GPU Computing
basics.summary: Second-year PhD candidate at the University of Cambridge, combining the latest statistical and probabilistic machine learning methods with modern hardware accelerators to solve previously intractable inference problems in cosmology. I develop physically motivated forward models and scalable inference methods with rigorous Bayesian uncertainty quantification, applied to global 21-cm cosmology with REACH and to next-generation interferometers such as the SKA Observatory.
